for_senior_author: Risk of bias re-appraised with the editors' narrative-review checklist (instrument none-applicable) in place of AMSTAR 2. Overall is now high (the worst domain, the absent search), in place of the AMSTAR 2 critically low confidence; an instrument correction rather than a change of view.

Domain disagreement to settle: 'Appraisal of cited studies'. The reader proposed high; I judge some concerns. The review never appraises an individual study (no sample sizes, randomization, blinding, doses or magnitudes, so the animal literature is never weighed as SYRCLE would weigh it), but it names the limits of its evidence base at length: a subsection on body-mass scaling and why rodent thermoregulation does not extrapolate to humans, species reversals wherever they occur, the statement that no manipulation has produced a clear picture, and an association it says was never tested. That is the standard the model card sc_kish_2017 records as some concerns. Overall is high either way.

Interpretation gap agreed ('substantial'), with the reader's note that a reader could argue for 'minor' since the gap is confined to two sentences; both are in the abstract, both are about people, and the abstract is what gets quoted.
The October 2014 print-issue date in reporting issue 7 is single-reader: the saved page gives only 14 May 2014. The card now says so. The citation year is 2014 either way.
